datasheet_identity.title: DSK32 THRU DSK320 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage VRRM is 200 V and maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) is 3.0 A at Ta = 25 degC (p. 1).
Non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM is 80 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave (p. 1).
The DSK320 forward curve is in the DSK315-DSK320 family group; the plot does not provide a DSK320-only trace.
No reverse-recovery time or breakdown characteristic is published.
